messages.subject: Project Onyx — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Thank you for instructing us on the proposed acquisition of Onyx Point in Coventry. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope, team and our fee estimate of £42,000–£52,000 plus VAT and disbursements. James Osei will have day-to-day conduct.

Once you've signed and returned the enclosed copy we'll open the file and start title and lease review as soon as the seller's solicitors release the data room. Could you confirm the SPV name you intend to use as purchaser?

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0512
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
